# GitAll

> Unified contribution heatmap viewer for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Gitea/Forgejo.

GitAll (gitall.app) lets developers see their contribution squares across all major
git platforms in one place. Enter usernames to view side-by-side or integrated
heatmaps. Free, no login required.

Supported platforms: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, Forgejo, and Codeberg.
Signing in with GitHub additionally surfaces private GitHub contributions and lets a
user claim a public profile handle.

## Docs

- [Full reference](https://gitall.app/llms-full.txt): complete feature list, supported
  platforms, embed formats, and privacy behaviour in one file.
- [README](https://github.com/Toastbyte-Studios/git-all/blob/main/README.md): setup,
  architecture, and local development.
- [Privacy policy](https://gitall.app/privacy): what is stored, for how long, and what
  is sent to each platform's API.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Toastbyte-Studios/git-all/blob/main/SECURITY.md):
  how to report a vulnerability.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gitall.app/): username lookup and the embed snippet generator.
- [Public profile](https://gitall.app/u/): a claimed handle's verified heatmap, at
  `/u/{handle}`.
